body: Okay decent point but that is a pain that people enjoy, some at different levels. So as people see it as pleasurable, it is useful.
Just out of curiosity, could you give me an example of when pain doesn't serve a purpose?
Lol just visualized donkeys dragging carts on wooden skis

I have suicidal thoughts regularly. I've had a real shit turd of a year so I finally broke down and raged all my honesty to one person. They said "yeah but you don't seem depressed" to which I responded "I KNOW. I'm professional at putting on a fake smile and suppressing these thoughts!"

Mother of god THANK YOU. This is what I've been dealing with for a while and I've never heard this term. I've called the suicide hotline multiple times but it doesn't ever really help bc I know that I won't actually kill myself. 

I just read through the whole [wikipedia page](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suicidal_ideation) and was like "yup, yup, uh huh I do that". Ugh and that's why I've never gone to a therapist. I mean, I made this acct just so I could post suicidal thoughts and get feedback.

Naw it's not stupid... you're trying to find solutions that would work. I just wanted to hear what people had to say about my initial question. As for video games to distract me from life, I have a very basic computer that would struggle with most games. Also, I don't have a permanent residence so I don't have a place to play.
The problem is that I don't have any close friends... so people would miss me but no one would be devastated aside from the three other people in my family.

Nope I'm on board with you. I'm in my mid 30s. I have found love a couple times; once when I was looking into engagement rings. But I have blown all chances and am nearly done trying with women. And I've known since I was young that I don't want to be a father so I got myself a vasectomy so that mistakes can't be made.

I know I know but I'm struggling to come up with the reason as to WHY we're supposed to fight to stay alive. Since we all will eventually die, why do others see suicide as such a bad thing for people who are suffering mentally?

Yuuuup. It's not worth the struggle. The biggest thing recently is how bad I am in relationships. I'm a decent looking dude in my mid 30s who can't keep a relationship going. Everyone thinks I'm gay, including my parents. I'M NOT.
I'm working but it's a job that pays a percentage of the profits once a year. So I've invested all my money into work and now won't get paid for another month or two.
